next.reason: Integer arguments (§2023:15.3 AR6 adds 'or an integer data item', already an integer arithmetic expression) and the ALL-subscript expansion (§2023:15.3 AR14, §2023:8.4.2.3.4 GR1) carry over. But 1989 says out-of-range arguments make 'the returned value for the function ... undefined'; §2023:15.3 AR14 instead sets 'the EC-ARGUMENT-FUNCTION exception condition' and leaves the result implementor-defined when checking is off. Different run-time result; no compile-time refusal changed.
